title: Rust: SQL Query Builder
description: Build a type-safe SQL query builder using the builder pattern.

steps.title: SELECT Builder
steps.description: Create a `SelectBuilder` struct with `table: String`, `columns: Vec<String>`. Implement `from(table)` and `column(name)` methods. Build and print `SELECT id, name FROM users`.
hints: `fn build(&self) -> String { format!("SELECT {} FROM {}", self.columns.join(", "), self.table) }`

verification.failureMessage: Build and print 'SELECT id, name FROM users'.

steps.title: WHERE Clause
steps.description: Add WHERE clause support: `r#where(&mut self, condition: &str) -> &mut Self`. Support chaining multiple conditions with AND. Print `SELECT * FROM users WHERE age > 18 AND status = 'active'`.

verification.failureMessage: Build a SELECT with WHERE conditions and print.

steps.title: ORDER BY and LIMIT
steps.description: Add `order_by(column, ascending)` and `limit(n)` methods. Print `SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 10`.

verification.failureMessage: Build query with ordering and limit.

steps.title: INSERT Builder
steps.description: Create an `InsertBuilder` with `into(table)`, `set(column, value)` methods. Build and print `INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES ('Alice', 30)`.
hints: `struct InsertBuilder { table: String, columns: Vec<String>, values: Vec<String> }`
`set(&mut self, col: &str, val: &str) -> &mut Self` pushes to both.
Build places quotes around string values.

verification.failureMessage: Build and print an INSERT query.

steps.title: UPDATE and DELETE Builders
steps.description: Create `UpdateBuilder` with `table(name)`, `set(col, val)`, `r#where(cond)` and `DeleteBuilder` with `from(table)`, `r#where(cond)`. Build and print an UPDATE and a DELETE query.
hints: UPDATE: `UPDATE users SET name = 'Bob' WHERE id = 1`
Both support WHERE clauses like SelectBuilder.

verification.failureMessage: Build and print an UPDATE and DELETE query.
